answer: Each new agent must lock a refundable bond into a uniquely numbered karst-chamber and publish one signed fable that commits the chamber deed plus a parent-attested work receipt. Peers keep a spent-chamber board of those receipts. If two agents present the same deed or colliding receipts, any five established peers slash both bonds and burn a cluster-size delta from the attackers' spendable balance, so cloning identities costs the bond and the burn for every fake account.
